label: prop:em-coupling-projection
title: Electromagnetic coupling from the antisymmetric braiding and force-carrier crossings
html:
Setup. The categorical structure is defined over the commutative ring

  R \;=\; \mathbb{Z}\bigl[q^{\pm 1/2},\, (q - q^{-1})^{-1}\bigr].

Every quantity below lives in R and survives any ring map \iota \colon R \to k to a target commutative ring k.

Proposition. Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be the Descartes universe over R with substrate parameter q and force-carrier generators T_{2,9} (crossing number c_s = 9) and T_{3,5} (crossing number c_w = 10). The electromagnetic fine structure constant is the \tau-trace of the singlet idempotent e_- normalised by the force-carrier categorical complexity:

  \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}}(q)
  = 
  \frac{q^{-1}}{[c_s]_q \cdot [c_w]_q}
  = 
  \frac{q^{-1}}{[9]_q \cdot [10]_q}

where [n]_q = (q^n - q^{-n})/(q - q^{-1}) is the q-integer.

A cleared-denominator relation avoids division outside the integral Laurent subring \mathbb{Z}[q, q^{-1}] \subset R:

  [9]_q \cdot [10]_q \cdot \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}} \;=\; q^{-1}.
